spam.title: Mark {{ticket}} as spam?
spam.body: The ticket closes with the Spam status. No auto-reply and no CSAT are sent, and it is left out of reports.
spam.blockHint: Their next messages are dropped. Undo from Ticketing › Spam.

logTime.title: Log time
logTime.caption: On {{reference}}, as {{name}}.
logTime.invalid: Minutes 0–59, hours 0–24. The total must be above zero.

csat.heading: Satisfaction
csat.shareHint: Channels do not deliver the link yet. Share it with the customer.
csat.copyFailed: The link could not be copied.

merge.title: Merge tickets
merge.description: The ticket you pick stays open; this one closes into it.
merge.searchHint: Search this brand by reference, subject or contact.
merge.closes: It closes as Merged, with no CSAT, and its SLA clocks stop.
merge.messages: Its messages stay where they are and show inline, read-only, in {{primary}}.
merge.tagsAndCc: Tags are combined. {{name}} is added to {{primary}} as a CC.
merge.pickOne: Pick the ticket to merge into.

split.title: Split into a new ticket
split.description: Same contact. Pick the messages that belong to a separate problem.
split.subject: Subject
split.note: Messages are copied, not moved. The new ticket gets a fresh number and fresh SLA clocks.

merged.intoThisBy: {{reference}} was merged into this ticket by {{name}} · {{time}}

lifecycle.ticket-merged: This ticket was merged into another one. Work on that one instead.
lifecycle.ticket-not-closed: This ticket is not closed, so there is nothing to reopen.
lifecycle.merge-into-self: A ticket cannot be merged into itself.
lifecycle.merge-into-merged: That ticket was itself merged. Merge into the ticket it went to.
lifecycle.ticket-not-merged: This ticket is not merged any more.
lifecycle.merge-window-closed: A merge can be undone for 24 hours, and those have passed.
lifecycle.attachments-in-flight: A file on those messages is still being processed. Try again in a moment.
lifecycle.merge-primary-deleted: The ticket this one was merged into has been deleted, so the merge cannot be undone.
lifecycle.ticket-not-spam: This ticket is not marked as spam.
